description_en: Calls the BatchDeleteDeviceGroupRelations operation to remove devices from a specified group in a batch. This operation only removes the association between devices and the group, and does not delete the devices themselves
description_zh: 调用BatchDeleteDeviceGroupRelations接口批量删除指定分组中的设备。该操作仅删除设备与分组的关联关系，不会删除设备本身
name: BatchDeleteDeviceGroupRelations

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group
parameters.help_zh: 分组ID，分组的全局唯一标识符
parameters.name: group_id

fields.help_en: The device name of the device you want to remove from the group. You can specify up to 200 device names
fields.help_zh: 要从分组中删除的设备名称，最多可传入200个
fields.name: device_name

fields.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device you want to remove from the group belongs. You can specify up to 200 ProductKeys
fields.help_zh: 要从分组中删除的设备所属产品的ProductKey，最多可传入200个
fields.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The list of devices to remove from the group
parameters.help_zh: 要从分组中删除的设备列表
parameters.name: device

AlreadyRelatedGroupDeviceCount.description_en: The number of devices that were added to the group before the deletion
AlreadyRelatedGroupDeviceCount.description_zh: 删除前，已添加到此分组的设备数量

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

SuccessDeviceCount.description_en: The number of devices that were successfully removed from the group
SuccessDeviceCount.description_zh: 成功从分组中删除的设备数量

ValidDeviceCount.description_en: The number of valid devices (devices that can be removed) among the devices specified in the request parameters
ValidDeviceCount.description_zh: 请求参数中要删除的设备中，有效的设备数量（即可删除的设备数量）
